entities.name: Jeska

events.summary: Jeska seals the last major rift in Otaria, healing all remaining fractures across Dominaria and the Multiverse.
events.quote: The Great Mending began when Jeska sealed the last major rift in Otaria in 4500 AR .

events.summary: Creatures from the Time Spiral crisis return to their original time and Dominaria's mana flows back into the land.
Planeswalkers lose immortality and godlike powers and existing planar travel tech stops working.
events.quote: Planeswalkers lost their immortality and godlike powers and much of their additional magic power.
